# nobus_lbaas_health_monitor (Resource)

A health monitor for a Nobus LBaaS pool.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nobus_lbaas_health_monitor" "web" {
  pool_id     = nobus_lbaas_pool.web.id
  type        = "HTTP"
  delay       = 5
  timeout     = 3
  max_retries = 3
  url_path    = "/health"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `max_retries` (Number)
- `pool_id` (String)
- `timeout` (Number)
- `type` (String)
